entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Non-human advisor to Lord Peemel in Iwset who secretly sought to overthrow him.

entities.name: Lord Peemel
entities.description: Lord of the city-state of Iwset, stabbed in the back by Digody.

entities.name: Iwset

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Rival of Digody and secret lover of Lady Edara, who killed Digody.

entities.name: Lady Edara of Jehesic
entities.description: Woman kidnapped by Peemel; secret lover of Apepei.

entities.name: Isak Glen'Dard
entities.description: Shapeshifter sent by Digody to kill Sacumon.
